title: AI 代理与安全新纪元：跨云厂商的技术突破、合规升级与风险格局（2026‑11‑04）
core_insight: AI 代理与可信安全的深度融合正驱动云平台技术、应用与资本的结构性升级，同时新兴的 LLM‑jacking 与主权 AI 监管压力凸显供应链与合规风险。

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 推出 Lambda Web Functions，实现原生 HTTP 的无服务器计算；Google Cloud 持续发布 AI 代理工具链（agentic era、skill 定义），加速大模型驱动的云原生工作流；Azure发布《Evolving the cloud-native foundation for the next generation of AI》，强化容器、Serverless 与大模型协同。 AWS Continuum 将 AI 驱动的代码漏洞检测商业化，Bedrock 公开托管代理和 GPT‑6.1 Terra 模型；Step Functions 引入 Agent 工具；Google Cloud 通过 Database Migration Service 新增磁盘压缩功能提升存储效率；Azure推出硬件审计日志的 Cloud HSM，实现可验证的安全审计；Cloudflare推出 Post‑Quantum GeoKey Manager，提升密钥管理的抗量子安全。 Announcing AWS Lambda Web Functions AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available Leading in the agentic era: How to put people first as you adopt AI agents Azure Cloud HSM Hardware Audit Logging: Verifiable audit trails for security and compliance Evolving the cloud-native foundation for the next generation of AI Bringing post-quantum cryptography to geographically fenced key management Introducing Amazon ECS Gateway: A fully-managed ingress solution for ECS services Beyond Migration: Using Database Migration Service for disk shrinking Five rules for evaluating agent skills before they bloat your context window Azure Cloud HSM Hardware Audit Logging: Verifiable audit trails for security and compliance
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Google Cloud 推出通用费用上限（spend caps）功能，帮助企业在多区域部署时实现成本可控；Azure 围绕数字主权推出新区域与合规控制，提升在监管严格地区的可用性。 暂无新的芯片或 GPU 供给公告，绿色数据中心议题未见官方声明。 Innovate on your own business terms: Google Cloud spend caps now generally available Advancing digital sovereignty with greater control and choice 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵 Cloudflare services for private origins is now generally available
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce Health Insights 与 Tableau Data Apps 将 AI 分析推向医疗、金融、制药等高合规行业；Google Cloud Universal Ledger 在银团贷款等金融服务实现端到端自动化；火山引擎推出 ByteHouse 云数仓、DataLeap 大数据治理套件，面向金融、制造等实时分析需求行业。 AI 代理化 SaaS（Salesforce、HubSpot）与自定义 Claude 插件加速企业营销与运营自动化；Azure 通过硬件审计日志与主权 AI 框架帮助受监管行业实现合规上云；Cloudflare Private Origins 让企业安全将内部系统暴露至公网，推动混合云数字化转型。 Salesforce Health Insights: Know What to Fix First Tableau Data Apps: From Prompt to Trusted Agentic Analytics The Humane Agentic Enterprise: How To Thrive with AI at Work How Nammu21 automates syndicated loans on Google Cloud Universal Ledger
